quotations.old_english: Constantinus hét ðæt man cyricean timbrede, and ðæt man belúce ǽlc deófulgyldhús
quotations.english: Constantine ordered churches to be built, and every heathen temple to be closed

source_text: deófulgyld-hús, es; n. A heathen temple; pagan&o-long;rum templum :-- Constantinus hét ðæt man cyricean timbrede, and ðæt man belúce ǽlc deófulgyldhús Constantine ordered churches to be built, and every heathen temple to be closed, Ors. 6, 30; Bos. 127, 36.
